subject: E-Commerce
title: Shopify: The Anti-Marketplace
description: A 60-second lesson on Shopify: The Anti-Marketplace.

hook.text: Shopify powers 4.6 million stores and $236 B in sales. It helps brands own their store instead of renting on Amazon.

buildup.text: Shopify is the opposite of a marketplace. Each merchant gets their own website, branding, and customer relationships.

discovery.text: Shopify's pitch: build your own store, own your data, keep your customers. Amazon's pitch: access 300 million buyers.

twist.text: Most Shopify stores get little organic traffic. Without Amazon's built-in audience, merchants must drive their own.

climax.text: Shopify gives independence but not customers. Amazon gives customers but not independence.

punchline.text: $236B in sales, zero marketplace traffic. Shopify is freedom—with the burden.

quiz.question: What is the key trade-off between Shopify and Amazon for sellers?
options: Shopify offers independence but no built-in traffic; Amazon offers traffic but no independence
